subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Blame Culture vs Learning Culture
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Blame Culture vs Learning Culture.

hook.text: An employee makes an error and reports it. She gets fired. The next employee makes the same error and hides it.

buildup.text: Blame culture punishes mistakes. Learning culture investigates them. One prevents reporting; the other prevents repeats.

discovery.text: Aviation's safety record improved when it adopted 'just culture' — reporting errors without automatic punishment.

twist.text: Financial firms mostly still operate blame cultures. Errors are hidden, compounding risk until they explode.

climax.text: Organizations that learn from failures prevent future ones. Those that punish failures guarantee hidden risks.

punchline.text: Punish errors. People hide them. The risk grows silent.

quiz.question: What is the benefit of a 'just culture'?
options: People report errors openly so the organization can learn
Errors are automatically corrected by AI
